dictionary.pulpitVncNeedsHypervisorNote: Check QEMU or VirtualBox above first - VNC's host/port depends on which one manages this VM.
dictionary.pulpitAutoDiscoverNoneFound: No new hosts to add - everything from the last scan is already on the map.
dictionary.pulpitRemoteInstallerUrlHint: Paste the direct .exe link for the installer - QEMU/VirtualBox don't publish a stable "latest" link, so use the buttons below to open the official download page and copy it from there.
dictionary.pulpitRemoteRunMissingFieldsNote: Fill in host, username, password and an installer link first.
dictionary.pulpitRemoteRunPendingNote: Connecting and installing - this can take a while...
dictionary.pulpitPreviewNeedsHostNote: Set a host and VNC port above first.
dictionary.pulpitPreviewDesktopOnlyNote: Desktop preview needs a raw network connection - only available in the desktop app, not the web version.
dictionary.pulpitPreviewEmptyNote: No preview focused - start one from a computer's Inspector.
dictionary.toolText_mail_xss_tester: Send yourself an email containing several HTML/XSS payload variants - each one proves it executed by calling a unique beacon URL, so a payload your webmail sanitizes away simply never reports in. Desktop app only.

dictionary.mailXssTunnelStartingNote: Starting beacon listener and Cloudflare tunnel...
dictionary.mailXssSendMissingFieldsNote: Fill in your Gmail address, app password, recipient and subject first.
dictionary.mailXssSendSuccessNote: Sent - open it in your webmail and watch the hit log.
dictionary.toolText_google_dork: Compose an advanced Google search query (site:/filetype:/inurl:/intitle:/intext:, exact phrases, +include/-exclude) and open it in your browser - nothing is scraped in-app.
dictionary.googleDorkResponsibleUseNote: Uses only Google's own public search index - no scanning, no unauthorized access. You're responsible for what you do with anything you find.
dictionary.googleDorkQueryEmptyNote: Fill in at least one field to build a query.
dictionary.toolText_wifi: Scan nearby WiFi networks, check the current connection, and view saved profiles (with on-demand password reveal) - read-only, desktop only.
dictionary.wifiDesktopOnlyNote: Actions need the desktop app - they call netsh through the native backend, which the web build cannot do.
dictionary.wifiNearbyEmptyNote: No networks found - scan again, or check that a WiFi adapter is present and enabled.
dictionary.wifiRadarAriaLabel: Nearby networks, arranged by signal strength
dictionary.wifiRadarLegendNote: Networks placed clockwise by name; closer to center and greener = stronger signal, farther out and redder = weaker. Gray means signal strength wasn't reported for this network.
dictionary.wifiCurrentNotConnectedNote: Not connected to a WiFi network.
dictionary.wifiPasswordDeniedNote: Requires administrator - not available in this phase.
dictionary.wifiAdapterHostedNetworkNotReported: Not reported by this Windows version
dictionary.wifiAdapterFutureNote: Captured for a future Hotspot/Internet Connection Sharing feature.
